seo.title: Md Sumon Howlader — Founder, Durbin Films
seo.description: Md Sumon Howlader founded Durbin Films in 2021 and is the Editor and Publisher of Durbin News, the PID registered portal. A Dhaka producer building for a Bengali audience online since 2014.

name: Md Sumon Howlader
intro: Producer and publisher, working online full time since 2014. Founder of Durbin Films and Durbin News, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

profile.heading: Ten years of one audience
paragraphs: Md Sumon Howlader has worked online full time since 2014, years before a Bengali audience arrived on YouTube and Facebook in the numbers it has today. More than two thousand projects have passed through his hands since then, most of them short films and documentaries. That volume taught him what no one can teach a producer: what people stop for, and what they scroll past.

He founded Durbin Films in October 2021. The studio now works across three YouTube channels with more than two and a half million subscribers between them, producing television dramas, web series, and commercial work for brands. Its drama has aired on television as well as online. He produces across the full slate, from choosing the story and setting the budget to final delivery.

Four months after the studio, he launched Durbin News, registered by the Press Information Department as an online news portal in July 2022. He is its Editor and Publisher. Its main Facebook page reaches around 7.6 million followers and more than 500 million views a month, making it one of the most followed news outlets in Bangladesh.

items.title: Started working online full time
items.text: Began as a freelancer building digital projects, which became the base for everything after.

items.title: Durbin Films founded
items.text: Started the studio and moved into production: television drama, web series, commercials and brand films, produced end to end.

items.title: Durbin News founded
items.text: Launched the portal and built it into a government registered online news outlet with a national readership and a set of Durbin branded pages.

items.title: Both ventures registered
items.text: Durbin Films became a registered company on 1 July 2022. On 31 July 2022 Durbin News received its Press Information Department registration as online news portal no. 147.
